summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks for DSH. Configure shell commands that run automatically before/after model tool calls (pre-tool / post-tool) with a JSON payload on stdin; pre-tool non-zero exits block the call.
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks for DSH. Configure shell commands that run automatically before/after model tool calls (pre-tool / post-tool) with a JSON payload on stdin; pre-tool non-zero exits block the call.
